validation_retraining: at the start of each 2025 calendar month, refit the same frozen model using only samples whose target exit is strictly before month start
oos_retraining: at the start of each 2026 calendar month, refit the same frozen model using only samples whose target exit is strictly before month start; prior OOS months may enter later model fits as realized history
untouched_definition: OOS is untouched for model/feature/hyperparameter/candidate selection; sequential past outcomes may update model coefficients exactly as preregistered monthly walk-forward
candidate_selection: rank the two frozen thresholds on 2025 validation only; 2026 metrics are report-only
